gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Blink rates its cameras' motion detection as working best at about 7 to 19 ft (2 to 6 m), and that the Blink Outdoor 4 detects by heat (PIR). A feeder-mounted camera sits inches from the bird: Wyze needs an added diopter lens on its own Bird Feeder just to focus at 4 to 8 in.
standout_why: I compared against the four pages ChatGPT cited: Wyze 'Is 24/7 Local Recording going away?', Wyze 'Can Wyze Cam v3 record events continuously?', Blink 'Local Storage with Sync Module' and Blink 'Blink Storage Options'. I also checked uncited result #29 (Wyze, how the Bird Feeder takes close-up pictures). The cited pages cover only storage and subscriptions. None gives a working distance for detection or focus. Result #29 has the 4 to 8 in diopter figure, and ChatGPT's answer only said to 'test the focus distance'. No result gives Blink's 7 to 19 ft detection range or says the Outdoor 4 uses PIR, so we have the other half of the distance mismatch to ourselves. We also have the split between Wyze's free '24/7 Local Recording' and its paid 'SD Card CVR'; the Wyze CVR page was in the results but not cited.
decides: This backs ChatGPT's 'use Wyze if you have both' on new grounds. Wyze makes a close-up lens setup for its cameras, records to microSD 24/7 or on events with no plan, and detects motion from the picture. Blink's heat-based PIR is rated best at 7 to 19 ft. A case that holds a Blink inches from the seed is outside the range Blink states, and in two reviews, cameras in the Wasserstein case gave soft or 'too close to identify' shots of the nearest birds (both tested a Ring, not a Blink). The page should tell Blink owners to mount the camera a few feet back from the feeder, not inside it, or else set expectations for close-up sharpness.

findings.label: Motion detection method
findings.value: PIR (heat-based); Mini and Mini 2 use pixel difference instead
findings.note: The PIR list reads 'Blink Outdoor 4, Wired Floodlight, Outdoor and Indoor (3rd Gen), Blink Indoor (1st Gen), XT2 and XT'. Blink also says 'Objects that are the same apparent temperature as the background may not be detected when they move.'

findings.label: Stated best motion detection distance
findings.value: about 7 to 19 ft (2 to 6 m); responds up to 30 ft (10 m)
findings.note: Quote: 'Blink cameras detect motion best from about 7 to 19 feet (2m to 6m) away.' This is general guidance, not a bird-specific test. Blink states no lower distance limit.

findings.label: Focus range with Wyze's add-on lens
findings.value: 4 to 8 in, using a diopter ('myopic lens') in the Lens Bracket
findings.source_title: How does Wyze Bird Feeder take clear up-close bird pictures? – Wyze
findings.note: Wyze needs an added lens to get feeder-distance focus. The page gives no diopter value and says Wyze Cams are mostly used for 'security and monitoring, not for close-up observation of wildlife.'

findings.label: Compatible Wyze cameras
findings.value: Wyze Cam Outdoor v1/v2, Battery Cam Pro, Cam v3, v3 Pro, v4* (Cam OG not listed)
findings.source_title: Which Wyze Cams are compatible with Wyze Bird Feeder? – Wyze
findings.note: Wired cams need the Wyze Outdoor Power Adapter. Wyze doesn't explain the asterisk on v4.

findings.label: No-plan local recording vs 'SD Card CVR'
findings.value: 24/7 Local Recording (Continuous or Events Only) needs no subscription. 'SD Card CVR' (cloud plus card, one timeline) is a Cam Unlimited Pro feature.
findings.source_title: What is SD card Continuous Video Recording (CVR)? – Wyze
findings.note: Two names that sound like the same feature. The CVR page says 'you will still be able to use 24/7 Local Recording without a subscription.' The free mode is confirmed on https://support.wyze.com/hc/en-us/articles/32776621952539-Is-24-7-Local-Recording-going-away (updated May 14, 2026): 'Continuous or Events Only recording with no subscription required.'

findings.label: Event recording length, no plan vs Cam Plus
findings.value: No plan: Events Only on microSD records 'longer event videos… without a cooldown'. Cam Plus cloud events: 5-minute cooldown by default, which can be removed in settings.
findings.source_title: Can Wyze Cam v3 record events continuously? – Wyze
findings.note: The page uses 12-second event videos as its example. It gives no exact maximum length for microSD event clips.

findings.label: Days of footage per card
findings.value: up to 4 days on a 32 GB card (24/7 recording)
findings.source_title: How do Cam Plus and a microSD card compare? – Wyze
findings.note: From Wyze's comparison table. Cam Plus keeps 14 days in the cloud.

findings.label: Clip length and retrigger settings
findings.value: clip 5 to 60 s (Doorbell, Mini and Mini 2 capped at 30 s); retrigger 10 to 60 s
findings.note: No Outdoor 4 maximum is given. Person Detection, Photo Capture and Auto-Update Thumbnail need a Blink Subscription Plan.

findings.label: Local storage limits and supported cameras
findings.value: USB drive or microSD of 1 to 256 GB, with at least 375 MB free. Not supported on XT, XT2, Indoor (1st Gen) or Sync Module Core.
findings.source_title: Local Storage with Sync Module — Blink Support
findings.note: Blink Storage Options (https://support.blinkforhome.com/blink-storage-options) says local recording stops when the drive is full. Live view and two-way audio work without a plan.

findings.label: Close-focus result in review (Ring Stick Up)
findings.value: Pros and cons list: 'Security cameras can't focus closely enough'; birds were 'closer than the Ring's nearest focusing distance'
findings.source_title: Wasserstein Bird Feeder Smart Case review: Bird watching made easy? — Digital Camera World
findings.note: Adam Juniper, published 4 April 2023. Tested with a Ring Stick Up, not a Blink or Wyze. His verdict: the Ring 'wasn't able to get a completely crisp image of birds.'

findings.label: Nearest birds in review (Ring Stick Up HD)
findings.value: birds closest to the camera were 'in a blind spot outside the field of view or were too close to identify'; view covered about 75% of the tray; feeder 9 × 7 × 8 in
findings.source_title: Wasserstein Bird Feeder Smart Camera Case Review — Bob Vila
findings.note: Mark Wolfe, May 19, 2023. 30-day test with a Ring Stick Up HD. He also reported clear images 'from about 2 inches away all the way out to about 45 feet away'.

unsourced: Wyze Cam Close-Up Lens: price and focus distance. wyze.com and its en-ca page returned HTTP 429 on three tries, and storecheck.py also got 429.
Wasserstein Bird Feeder Camera Case: today's price and the camera-to-perch distance. The maker's page and storecheck.py returned HTTP 429, and neither review gives a lens-to-perch distance.

Stock minimum focus distance for Wyze Cam v3/OG and Blink Outdoor 4. Not stated on the Wyze or Blink support pages I read. The Wyze forum has only an unmeasured user recollection ('under a foot'), so I left it out.
Blink Outdoor 4 maximum clip length. Blink's Device Settings page gives 5 to 60 s overall with no Outdoor 4 figure.
Any review that tested the Wasserstein case with a Blink or a Wyze camera. Both reviews I opened used a Ring Stick Up.
